project_info.name: CyberHead Academy
project_info.theme: Dark cybersecurity aesthetic (Modern SaaS / SOC platform visual style)
project_info.hero_headline: Master Cybersecurity. One Skill at a Time.
project_info.hero_subheadline: Learn ethical hacking, bug bounty, web security, penetration testing and modern cybersecurity through practical learning.
project_info.waf_context: Serves as a controlled cybersecurity testing lab & YouTube demo for SafeLine WAF traffic inspection.

typography.code_font: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, source-code-pro, monospace

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-400

rules: DO NOT use generic Inter for large Headings. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk for Headings to establish brand authority.
Use JetBrains Mono / Code font for all technical stats, payload strings, IP addresses, WAF rules, and terminal outputs.
Headline letter-spacing must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 7 / PERFORMANCE PRO HYBRID (Dark Obsidian + Electric Cyan + Emerald Shield + Alert Amber)
gradient_rules: Use subtle radial background spots: `bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-cyan-950/40 via-slate-950 to-slate-950`.
Limit high-saturation cyan/emerald color strictly to CTAs, status badges, attack level badges, and metric highlights.

surface_styles.card_style: bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl hover:border-cyan-500/40 transition-all duration-300 shadow-lg shadow-black/40
surface_styles.glass_header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800/80 z-50 sticky top-0
surface_styles.waf_terminal: bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg font-mono text-xs p-4 text-emerald-400 overflow-x-auto shadow-inner

textures: Subtle subtle grid lines background overlay (`bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#1f293710_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#1f293710_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:4rem_4rem]`)
Glowing status indicator dots (pulse ping animation for Live WAF Status & Security Lab)

elements: Brand Logo with Cyan Cyber Shield
navigation.rule: Header MUST NOT be transparent without backdrop blur. Always readable against dark sections.

homepage: Hero Section with Live WAF Interactive Status Counter & CTA ('Explore Security Lab', 'Start Learning')
Trust & Statistics Banner (10,000+ Lab Exercises, 99.8% WAF Block Rate, 45+ Interactive Modules)
Popular Courses Grid (Bento style: Featured Course spans col-span-8, secondary span col-span-4)
Why CyberHead Academy (Practical Lab vs Theory, SafeLine WAF Integration, Real-world Attack Scenarios)
Security Lab Teaser Widget (Live Traffic Monitor Preview)
Enterprise Footer with status pill & quick links
courses_listing: Filterable Grid by Difficulty (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) and Category (Web Security, Pentesting, WAF & Defense, Bug Bounty)
Course Cards: Thumbnail image, Category Badge, Title, Instructor Avatar + Name, Rating, Duration, Lessons Count, Price tag, Enroll Button
course_details: Hero Header with course meta, enroll action, instructor info, difficulty badge
Module & Lesson Curriculum Accordion with interactive preview modal/drawer
student_dashboard: Overview Metrics: Security Score (850/1000), Labs Completed, Enrolled Courses, Hours Spent
Enrolled Courses Progress Cards with linear progress bars
Recent Security Lab Activity Feed with status badges (BLOCKED by SafeLine WAF, PASSED, MITIGATED)
Personalized Skill Radar / Next Recommended Module
security_lab_dashboard: WAF Traffic Monitor (SafeLine WAF Status: Active Protection)
Real-time Request Log Feed (Timestamp, Source IP, Target Endpoint, Attack Type e.g., SQLi/XSS/Command Injection, Action e.g., Blocked 403 / Allowed 200)
Attack Visualizer Chart (Requests vs Blocked threats over time)
Simulate Attack Request Generator (Triggers SafeLine WAF rule demonstration)
api_docs: Interactive REST API Specification for CyberHead Lab & WAF Inspection
Code Snippet view in cURL, Python, and JavaScript with copy-to-clipboard

motion_and_interactivity.library: framer-motion, lucide-react icons, recharts / chart.js for graphs
micro_interactions: Hover scaling on course cards (scale-102 with border accent shift)
Smooth accordion open/close for curriculum and FAQs
Pulse glow on SafeLine WAF status badge ('PROTECTED')
Live request log stream with subtle entrance animation

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST include explicit kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_rules: Text on dark background must maintain minimum 4.5:1 ratio (slate-200/slate-300 on slate-900).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a sleek, high-end SaaS cybersecurity platform called CyberHead Academy.
Do NOT make it look like cheap green matrix rain or a standard DVWA lab; make it look like a $50M cybersecurity startup (like Hack The Box, TryHackMe, or Snyk).
Integrate the SafeLine WAF testing lab functionality cleanly in the 'Security Lab' section with live metrics, attack simulation triggers, and real-time request log monitoring.
Ensure all JS files follow clean React component structure and use Lucide icons.
Always set data-testid on buttons, inputs, tabs, and key metric cards.
